# Original domain matching reference

`sing-domain-reference.json` contains168 cases generated by reference-main.go
using the exact primary dependency github.com/sagernet/sing
v0.9.7-0.20260929150544-0ad23b637bd4/common/domain.NewMatcher.
The keyword branch mirrors route/rule/rule_item_domain_keyword.go in the pinned
sing-box-lx-mcrf-clash-20261014 source: lowercase observed host, literal keyword.
No network requests or throughput samples are involved.

These cases intentionally distinguish leading-dot suffixes, terminal dots,
case-sensitive supplied patterns, and punctuation inside keywords. An empty
observed host does not match. They cover ASCII/A-label hostnames only.

Reproduce in an external temporary Go module with a replace directive pointing
to that exact immutable dependency, then run this main file and serialize its
JSON output with indentation. The source matcher files and generator hashes
are recorded in the build-root bs-routing-domain-reference-01 receipt.
